verdict.rationale: Sift's docs state it offers official SDKs for iOS and Android plus a JavaScript snippet, alongside REST APIs (Events, Decisions, Score), so there is first-party SDK support to build against. The evidence is a single thin mention covering mobile and client-side only, and an early user called the documentation slightly confusing during integration. Missing for 10: evidence of server-side language SDKs, in-depth SDK documentation or references, AI/agent-oriented tooling, and independent hands-on corroboration of SDK quality.
